run_task_to_xml: run task_to_xml with 'flat_terrain' to get the feet-only flat terrain XML path
create_task_to_xml_rough: create a call to task_to_xml with 'rough_terrain' to get the feet-only rough terrain XML path
review_FEET_SITES: review the FEET_SITES constant listing left_foot and right_foot site names
review_HAND_SITES: review the HAND_SITES constant listing left_hand and right_hand site names
review_FEET_GEOMS: review the FEET_GEOMS constant combining left and right foot geom names
